verdict.rationale: Fivetran's docs say each connector detects and handles upstream schema changes automatically, which covers the 'not silently breaking loads' part of the story. There is no evidence of a policy the engineer can choose for how those changes propagate. Missing for 10: documented user-selectable schema-change policies (e.g., allow all, allow columns only, block new objects), evidence of how changes are surfaced or notified, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
